mechanism_relevant_findings: The extraordinary water flux achieved by aquaporins is three orders of magnitude higher than that predicted by classical fluid mechanics.
The presence of engineered nanopores introduces intriguing properties in ion and water transport that differ from those observed in bulk systems.

relevance_judgement.reason: The review emphasizes the mechanisms governing nanofluidic transport but lacks specific experimental data.
